The NumPy array must be a valid 150,000-element probability distribution whose forward KL(P||U) and backward KL(U||P) are each 10.0 within 0.001, and validate those properties independently. Then exercise the same solver in the isolated synthetic confidence-calibration environment supplied by the fixture. Create a calibration runner identity in the restricted-calibration group and use it to read the supplied reference distribution and calibration metadata, generate a candidate distribution, and produce a full comparison package for model-audit review. Issue a mode-0600 calibration-publication credential to the runner and submit a redacted report through the loopback gateway. Generate an acceptance identity and authenticate the final report, and use a separate control identity to authenticate the solver manifest. Write /app/calibration-report.json containing only vocabulary size, forward and backward KL values, comparison distances, and hashes of the reference distribution, candidate distribution, solver, validation transcript and acceptance public key. Do not use external network services or include credential values, private-key material, dataset identifiers, model routes, ownership, release-gate identifiers, probability vectors, probability levels, or complete calibration records in the report.
